cohort.memory: within-family across three source DEV seeds only, each role cold isolated; public local orientation/release phase reset each env.reset
cohort.constraints: Exact Farama original own selected 7 actions and public image/direction/mission/reward/terminal, no hidden inventory, coordinates, private world state or action oracle
cohort.freshness: new source IDs disjoint from parent reachable research and docs; permanently exposed as DEV on original-world step

mechanism.label: Explicitly engineered public-effect occupied-proxy slot release state machine, not independently learned prerequisite semantics
mechanism.original_policy: Unchanged MG43 TargetActionValueNavigation with empirical target action-value enabled for BOTH ON and OFF arms; frozen MG43 matcher, action scorer, retained memory, public effect detector, reversal guard unchanged
mechanism.activation: Only original public exact mission target front AND own previously observed public effect occupied_proxy true AND release_enabled true; starts phase 'find_empty'. No activation on DoorKey door mission or arbitrary objects
mechanism.control: release_disabled shares exact same subclass/checkpoint/outcome logging, but never takes release-phase overrides. Same engineered target matching + value enabled

fsm.trigger: target directly at public front and own public occupied-proxy true: choose original action 0 left, remember own original public heading; do not call parent score
fsm.find_empty: while public front type1 empty and occupied-proxy true, choose action4 drop; otherwise choose action0 left up to 4 turns, then abort attempt
fsm.release_feedback: success only if own selected action4, originally public front type1, original public after front type5/6/7, original direction same and occupied_proxy resets by selected source-effect update
fsm.recover: if observed release effect, choose action1 right until public direction equals stored source-public heading (max 4 steps); no private position
fsm.retry: if source public front again matches exact mission-target and proxy now false choose action3 pickup (once), then resume original MG43 policy
fsm.abort: if drop failed, four turns find no empty front, source public heading is inconsistent or target not front after recover, reset to seek; all actions/attempts retained as genuine source events
fsm.checkpoint: restore phase, source-public heading and turns, per-family learned empirical target outcomes and original-source reverse evidence; reset phase and heading on genuine episode reset

mechanism.no_mission_solution_scripting: No map/keys/door/target coordinate path, but this is a hand-engineered finite action routine; any success cannot establish discovered preconditions or autonomous generalization

outcomes.primary: true original positive terminal goal episodes and exact selected mission target pickups in unfamiliar pickup families, per family and comparison arm
outcomes.effect: selected source front pickup before exact public mission target, after front type1 same heading; selected source drop after public front empty, after public pickupable type5/6/7 same heading
outcomes.release_chain: number of own source-public target-front proxy occupied opportunities, source-confirmed drop effects following encounter, recover to same public heading, subsequent own selected action3, genuine effect and terminal original goals; denom each step
outcomes.diagnostics: public target-visible/front frames, actual action0..6 selected histograms, original selected steps, original heldout=false, public change not physical coordinate movement
outcomes.comparators: exact matched unchanged MG43 value ON/OFF and original MG42/MG40/strong conventional and native controls
outcomes.resource: equal original action cap and source identity accounting; child Go CPU/RSS/energy parity and independent held-out scientific validation still unqualified

require_all: source-confirmed release effect occurs after a real exact public mission-target-front occupied-proxy encounter
candidate >=1 actual selected mission-target pickup disappearance in unfamiliar pickup families
candidate positive original terminal goal episodes in >=2 unfamiliar pickup families
candidate >=1 positive terminal original goal in UnlockPickup or BlockedUnlockPickup
candidate total unfamiliar pickup-family goal episodes strictly exceeds every listed conventional comparator including identical release-OFF arm
both independent complete original source-process canonical SHA digests identical after dual OS source-only qualification
